license.wikipedia_evidence: CC BY-SA; preserve attribution and verify the applicable dump license

wikipedia_corpus.integrity: Pinned by huggingface_revision; individual files use Hugging Face LFS SHA-256 objects

default_subset.sampling_rule: per-label topic round-robin; sorted IDs then seeded shuffle
default_subset.topic_key: upstream domain, otherwise first evidence page, otherwise unknown
default_subset.selection_audit: Generated manifests record selected_source_ids, topic_counts, actual claims_sha256, and wikipedia_input_sha256

conversion_policy.claims_verification: Require pinned dev digest and split by default; --allow-unverified quarantines other inputs
conversion_policy.wikipedia_verification: Local file hashes are recorded, not assumed to match upstream; CLI snapshots remain quarantined pending review
conversion_policy.evidence_sets: AND within each group, OR across groups; retrieve the union of every group
conversion_policy.invalid_input: Reject malformed pointers, missing pages/lines, duplicate IDs, blank claims, unsafe split names before writing snapshots
conversion_policy.confidence: Converter-derived, not upstream gold; expected claims disable confidence scoring
conversion_policy.project_split: Assign development/holdout by topic after review while preserving upstream split
